verdict.rationale: Appwrite's Auth docs directly claim the ability to track which signed-in users are active right now and to broadcast online, typing, and viewing status in realtime. That covers both presence and ephemeral state broadcast. It is supported by the broader realtime capability for server events and databases. missing for 10: API-level documentation of the presence/broadcast mechanism (channels, payload limits, arbitrary custom ephemeral state beyond online/typing/viewing), independent or hands-on corroboration.
